text: Well, that's what we get for overlooking the Bears: Caleb Williams torched the Patriots for two touchdown passes in a 30-24 loss on Thursday Night Football, a result that has everybody from Mike Vrabel on down pointing to turnover differential as the prime culprit—one of the coach's four pillars, and wouldn't you know it, exactly where New England is hemorrhaging. The good news is we get a quick turnaround to face Miami on Sunday at 4:25 PM ET (or 4:15 depending on which press release you believe), though in the meantime the organization made some practice squad adjustments by re-signing linebacker Jose Ramirez while releasing both offensive lineman Jacob Rizy and punter Bryce Baringer from injured reserve. On a lighter note, Rob Gronkowski's Hall of Fame induction ceremony is set for Saturday, November 7 at Patriot Place Plaza, and if you need something to feel good about in the interim, Rhamondre Stevenson continues doing all those thankless little things that keep him on pace for his sixth straight 100-carry season—true quiet excellence while the chaos swirls around him.
